name: Cable Crossover Lat Pulldown
steps: Stand centered between two high pulleys with feet staggered or shoulder-width apart and hold one handle in each hand above shoulder level.
Brace your core and draw your elbows down toward your ribs until the handles reach beside your hips.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your lats while keeping your chest lifted.
Guide both handles out and back up under control until your arms fully extend.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso upright throughout the pull.
Depress your shoulder blades instead of letting your shoulders shrug toward your ears.
